home.funding.title: How we are funded
home.funding.body: EmpireCommunity runs on voluntary donations. The first milestone is R$ 5,384.99, to build our own server, with a Xeon and 128 GB of RAM, to host more game servers. After that, community costs continue: server power, upgrades, hosting and domains. Money donations are not open yet.

organization.title: Organization
organization.lead: EmpireCommunity is a community of gamers and technology enthusiasts, based in Brazil.
organization.origin.title: How it started
organization.origin.p1: It all started with the difficulty of finding people to play with. The founder always enjoyed strategy and building games and imagined what it would be like to play them with friends. But playing together was not enough: the world only existed while someone was online. That led to the desire to host the games, so that anyone could join at any time.
organization.origin.p2: On August 20, 2022, the Discord server was born. People with the same interest kept arriving, the community grew and, together, we raised funds to host servers, mainly Minecraft with modpacks.
